name: Perigee Diving-Station
core_rationale: Lowest inhabited brass-and-basalt diving-bell sanctuary of Continent 03 at [1, 1] where tether-divers winch salvage cages down toward the northern ocean maelstrom.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Pressurized moon-pool basins where upward sea-foam condenses into calm lantern-lit canals

North.lock_message: Crushing inverted tidal shear along the Maelstrom Eye Lip snaps unreinforced tether-lines; Dive-Master Corin requires the Keel Gyro-Compass before opening the northern sea-lip.

resident_npcs.name: Dive-Master Corin
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Mind the upward spray! Check your diving-bell seals at my 0.60 meter winch desk before descending into the Submerged Orrery Keel.

resident_npcs.name: Pearl-Wright Naia
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Our eastern starlight tether-bridge now ascends directly to Comet-Tether Span in the Aphelion Halo Rim!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Perigee Abyss at [1, 1] directly above Vesper's northern whirlpool scar and connects East to Aphelion Halo Rim.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A brass-and-basalt diving-bell sanctuary suspended over an inverted ocean maelstrom with glowing moon-pools.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Winch desks at 0.58 to 0.60m, basalt risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.20m x 1.65m, and 13.0m boardwalks for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-stalactite-plunge, East portal to hunting-area-comet-tether-span, Dungeon portal to dungeon-submerged-orrery-keel, and North fog_of_lore portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Maelstrom Eye Lip behind a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Dive-Master lock message.
